Job Summary
We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Data Collection & Analysis Staff to join our team at PT Multi Farmindo Jaya. This role involves systematically gathering, organizing, and interpreting various data sets to support informed decision-making across the company.

Job Responsibilities
* Design and implement effective strategies for data collection from various sources, including internal systems, external databases, surveys, and field observations.
* Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of collected data through rigorous validation and cleaning processes.
* Develop and maintain robust databases and data management systems to store and retrieve information efficiently.
* Perform statistical analysis, data modeling, and trend identification to extract meaningful insights from complex datasets.
* Create clear, concise, and impactful reports, dashboards, and visualizations to present findings to relevant stakeholders.
* Collaborate with various departments (e.g., production, sales, marketing) to understand their data needs and provide analytical support.
* Identify areas for process improvement in data collection and analysis methodologies.
* Stay updated with industry best practices and emerging technologies in data management and analytics.
* Assist in the development and implementation of data governance policies and procedures.

Job Qualifications
* Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Technology, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
* Proven experience in data collection, data entry, and data analysis.
* Proficiency in data analysis tools and software (e.g., Microsoft Excel, SQL, R, Python, SPSS, SAS).
* Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus.
* Strong understanding of statistical concepts and data modeling techniques.
* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Bahasa Indonesia.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.

KUALIFIKASI :

• Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 semua jurusan.
• Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun sebagai Admin Warehouse, Admin Logistik, atau posisi administrasi yang berkaitan.
• Mampu mengoperasikan Microsoft Office, terutama Excel (VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, Pivot Table, dan pengolahan data).
• Memahami proses administrasi pergudangan seperti penerimaan barang, pengeluaran barang, stock opname, dan pengelolaan dokumen warehouse.
• Memiliki kemampuan dalam melakukan pencatatan dan monitoring stok secara akurat.
• Teliti, rapi, detail, dan memiliki kemampuan administrasi yang baik.
• Mampu bekerja dengan target serta memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan koordinasi yang baik.
• Terbiasa menggunakan sistem ERP/WMS menjadi nilai tambah.
• Bersedia bekerja di lingkungan operasional warehouse dan melakukan pengecekan data lapangan apabila diperlukan.
• Memiliki integritas tinggi, disiplin, dan mampu bekerja secara individu maupun dalam tim.
• Bersedia ditempatkan di Nganjuk, Jawa Timur.

TANGGUNG JAWAB PEKERJAAN:

• Melakukan pencatatan dan administrasi seluruh aktivitas keluar masuk barang di warehouse.
• Memastikan data penerimaan, penyimpanan, dan pengeluaran barang tercatat secara akurat dan tepat waktu pada sistem.
• Membuat dan mengarsipkan dokumen warehouse seperti Goods Receipt (GR), Delivery Order (DO), Surat Jalan, dan dokumen pendukung lainnya.
• Melakukan monitoring dan rekonsiliasi stok fisik dengan data sistem secara berkala.
• Mendukung pelaksanaan stock opname harian, bulanan, maupun tahunan serta menindaklanjuti selisih stok yang ditemukan.
• Menyusun dan menyiapkan laporan stok, laporan penerimaan barang, serta laporan pengeluaran barang secara rutin.
• Berkoordinasi dengan tim warehouse, procurement, produksi, dan logistik terkait pergerakan barang dan kebutuhan administrasi.
• Memastikan kelengkapan dan kerapian dokumen administrasi warehouse sesuai dengan prosedur perusahaan.
• Membantu pengelolaan data inventory untuk memastikan akurasi dan ketersediaan stok.

wo-klbf-JR26_001997.d:
Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

Job Description

- Bertanggungjawab dalam pengembangan metode analisis bahan baku, produk jadi dan prosedur pembersihan (cleaning validation).

- Bertanggungjawab dalam melakukan verifikasi metode analisis bahan baku dan verifikasi awal metode produk jadi.

- Bertanggungjawab dalam menyusun dokumen pengembangan produk dan dokumen yang dibutuhkan untuk registrasi produk.

- Bertanggungjawab dalam melakukan analisis sampel bahan baku dan produk jadi pada tahapan lab trial serta melakukan data analisis terhadap hasil pengujian sampel.

- Bertanggungjawab untuk melakukan transfer metode analisis bahan baku dan produk jadi.
